articles.title: Binance hack fallout, U.S. midterms and jobs report: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 2.

articles.title: Live updates: Binance records $6 billion outflows after starting withdrawals, less then 4% of total holdings
articles.description: The outflows followed a 45-hour withdrawal freeze after a $6.3 billion theft, with rival exchanges attracting deposits as customers regained access to their funds.

articles.title: Ryanair CEO warns fares could rise by up to 20% in 2027 as fuel bill jumps by $2.2 billion
articles.description: Ryanair's CEO Michael O'Leary told CNBC that European airlines may have "significantly higher airfares" of up to 20% next year as fuel costs rise.

articles.title: China’s Communist Party calls for a crackdown on corruption that uses crypto and blockchain
articles.description: China's Communist Party has named virtual currency and blockchain in a new anti-corruption call.

articles.title: Why stealing billions from a crypto exchange can be harder to stop than a bank theft
articles.description: The $6.3 billion Binance breach has revived a debate over whether crypto exchanges are less secure than banks or simply harder to protect once hackers get inside.

articles.title: Apollo launches $11 billion private credit platform, backed by Abu Dhabi
articles.description: Apollo has launched a 10 billion euro European private credit platform backed by major global investors.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs sink into October outflows with $643M exit after Binance hack
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended October with $515 million in net withdrawals, while Ether funds posted a record $1.61 billion in monthly outflows.

articles.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?
articles.description: AI is flagging hazards on construction sites, but researchers say evidence that the technology prevents injuries remains limited.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
articles.description: The first trading day after the Binance hack saw the biggest ETF outflow since June 25.

articles.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
articles.description: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

articles.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
articles.description: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

articles.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
articles.description: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

articles.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows as withdrawals resume after massive hack
articles.description: Binance recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after resuming withdrawals following a $6.3 billion hack, representing 2.1% of its total assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
articles.description: ZEC led the majors and oil slid on a report that Trump wants to give Iran diplomacy more time, with U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.

articles.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
articles.description: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

articles.title: Canada-India $5.5 billion bank takeover attracts opposition from workers, politicians
articles.description: IDBI workers demand the government "cancel the privatization process" and work to strengthen the bank while protecting public investment and staff interests.

articles.title: Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
articles.description: The central bank is surveying 31 financial institutions on how a major exchange shutdown, prolonged crypto downturn or losses at another firm could affect their operations.

articles.title: Sam Altman makes surprise South Korea visit as OpenAI builds on chip partnerships
articles.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman made an unannounced visit to South Korea over the weekend, meeting with Samsung executives and reportedly SK Group executives.

articles.title: Rubio says Trump wants to end Iran war 'peacefully' even as both sides prepare for strikes
articles.description: The remarks come as reports suggest that both sides are gearing up for additional military strikes after the U.S. midterm elections.

articles.title: THORChain halts swaps after block reorg bug, slowing Binance hackers
articles.description: THORChain node operators paused swaps involving assets on 10 networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Tron.
